craft_notes: Sthāyin: hoping shine. Device: end-dash→comma (attaining softens onto hoping). Rejected: 'fay' — kept lover. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Tasted and done with seeming's goods, the top seat I shall attain,
so runs hope: bright may it burn for Śambhu's lover.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhuktvā bhogān bhavabhrāntiṃ hitvā lapsye paraṃ padam ity āśaṃseha śobheta śambhau bhaktimataḥ param

reads_against.argmap: Having enjoyed enjoyments, having dropped becoming-delusion, I will attain the supreme state.; Thus the hope here: may it shine supremely of the devout in Śambhu. → Enjoyed and dropped, may attainment-hope shine in Śambhu.
c1_essence: Tasted and shed: highest seat hoped bright for the lover.
reads_against.l2: Tasted my fill and shed birth's mirage, I shall win the highest seat — so hope runs here: bright may it blaze for Śambhu's lover.
l3: Tasted and done with seeming's goods, the top seat I shall attain —
